subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` ever stat transcript-mentioned paths outside the fs-safe workspace root, or must the fix preserve containment by filtering or neutralizing those entries?
rationale: The current branch makes a security-boundary behavior choice by exposing external path metadata; automation should not choose that contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Restore the workspace boundary
options.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and keep session-file metadata behind fs-safe containment while adding outside-root, symlink-rejected, and directory regression coverage.

options.title: Split layout from file semantics
options.body: Land or preserve only a reconciled UI layout fix and leave external/directory Missing semantics to the linked backend issue path.

options.title: Accept external metadata deliberately
options.body: Allow transcript-mentioned external metadata only with explicit security acceptance, protocol/UI tests, and documented product behavior.

recommendation.title: Restore the workspace boundary
recommendation.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and keep session-file metadata behind fs-safe containment while adding outside-root, symlink-rejected, and directory regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workspace file preview and browsing boundary work makes this the closest available owner signal for the external metadata contract decision.
